info.title: Zuno Agent BFF API
info.description: Per-agent Backend-for-Frontend (ADR-0008) sitting between components/agent-frontend and the shared Agent Runtime. One BFF deployment per agent (v0: Tekos only) - AGENT_NAME selects which agent's Runtime path this instance calls. No public OpenShift Route: only components/agent-frontend calls this API, over its in-cluster Service. Authored as JSON rather than YAML so components/agent-bff's contract_test.go can parse it with encoding/json alone, preserving this component's deliberate zero-external-Go-dependency property (see README.md).

servers.description: In-cluster Service (Tekos deployment, v0's only agent)

post.summary: Submit one chat turn for this agent
post.description: Validates the caller's bearer JWT and the agent_<AGENT_NAME> entitlement group (ADR-0040), then forwards the turn to the shared Agent Runtime (ADR-0032 identity propagation - the same validated token is forwarded, never a service credential). Returns a buffered JSON reply by default, or relays a Server-Sent Events stream byte-for-byte (ADR-0045) when the caller sends Accept: text/event-stream.

parameters.name: Accept
parameters.description: text/event-stream requests the SSE variant of this response (ADR-0045) instead of the default synchronous JSON reply.

200.description: Synchronous JSON reply (default, Content-Type: application/json), or a Server-Sent Events stream (Content-Type: text/event-stream) when the request's Accept header asked for one (ADR-0045). The SSE variant is a sequence of frames, in order: one 'start' frame (SseStartEvent), zero or more 'tool' frames (SseToolEvent), zero or more 'token' frames (SseTokenEvent), then exactly one terminal frame - either 'done' (SseDoneEvent) or 'error' (SseErrorEvent). Each frame's data payload matches the named component schema below. OpenAPI 3.0 has no first-class way to type a stream of discriminated event payloads under one response, so they are documented in this prose plus as ordinary schemas under components.schemas rather than via a non-standard vendor extension a validator may not recognize.

401.description: Missing, invalid or expired bearer token.

403.description: Token is valid but lacks the agent_<AGENT_NAME> entitlement group (ADR-0040). The response never names which group was expected or which groups the caller actually has (Security considerations: "document authorization failures without leaking policy internals").

502.description: The Agent Runtime was unreachable or returned an error.

post.summary: Clone a conversation inside its own project (ADR-0527)
post.description: Any role from clone upward. Copies the source's full checkpoint into a fresh thread - no live sync back - keeping it in the SOURCE's project with a derived title. The cloner becomes the copy's owner, which is what makes the clone role useful rather than archival: they may write to their own copy while remaining unable to write to the original.

get.summary: Search colleagues eligible to be granted a role on a conversation (ADR-0213)
get.description: BFF-only - does not call the Agent Runtime. Calls Keycloak's Admin REST API via a dedicated confidential client (zuno-admin-api, view-users/query-users scope only) to search users by q, then computes eligibility: a candidate is eligible only if they hold this agent's agent_<AGENT_NAME> entitlement group AND share at least one business-role group with the caller. Ineligible candidates are still returned (eligible: false) so the frontend can grey them out rather than hide them. Fails closed (503) if the Keycloak Admin API client isn't provisioned (KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_CLIENT_ID/_SECRET unset) - never returns a silent empty list.

get.summary: List the projects the caller may see (ADR-0527)
get.description: Every live project the caller holds a grant on, directly or through one of their business-role groups, with their effective role, their private star and a live conversation count. Deliberately not agent-scoped: a project is cross-agent (ADR-0527 clause 6), only its conversations are not.

post.description: The creator receives an admin grant, merged into whatever grants the dialog submitted, so a project can never be created unadministrable (ADR-0527 clause 3 - there is no owner column). put.summary: Save a project's whole desired state in one commit (ADR-0527)
put.description: The single-save commit behind the two-tab dialog: everything the user changed arrives at once, which is why ADR-0527 needs one endpoint where ADR-0213 needed five per-member ones. The write role covers title and context; changing grants or the Salesforce link requires admin and is refused with 403 rather than silently ignored.

get.summary: List the business-role groups that may be project grant targets (ADR-0527)
get.description: BFF-only - never forwarded to the Agent Runtime, and rides the same zuno-admin-api Keycloak Admin API trust boundary ADR-0213 introduced for /api/colleagues. Needs the realm-management query-groups role in addition to WP-066's view-users/query-users; never manage-users, never manage-realm. agent_* entitlement groups are filtered out: ADR-0040 keeps entitlement and business role apart, and offering one here would turn 'shared with the consultants' into 'shared with everyone who can open this agent'.

401.description: Missing, invalid or expired bearer token.

403.description: Token is valid but lacks the agent_<AGENT_NAME> entitlement group.

503.description: The group directory is unavailable - either the zuno-admin-api Keycloak client is not provisioned, or the Admin API call failed (including the 403 returned when the service account lacks query-groups). Deliberately never a 200 with an empty list, which would read as 'this realm has no groups' and quietly prevent every group grant.

bearerAuth.description: Keycloak-issued OIDC access token (RS256) - the same token the caller (components/agent-frontend) already received from the user's browser session and this service independently revalidates against Keycloak's JWKS (ADR-0013), never a service credential of the BFF's own. Never echoed back in any response body or schema below (Security considerations: "never expose internal tokens in schemas").

session_id.description: Caller-generated correlation ID for this chat session.

project_id.description: ADR-0209: scopes this turn to a project's durable, cross-session, cross-agent memory (knowledge.project). Optional - omitted or empty means no project memory is read or written for this turn. Propagated to the Agent Runtime exactly as received, following the same identity-propagation pattern as ADR-0032/0033 - this BFF never validates or resolves project membership itself. ADR-0512 (WP-55): for a project_required task this is only a CANDIDATE - the Agent Runtime verifies it against Salesforce under the caller's own identity before trusting it, or blocks the request; for every other task it is unchanged, unverified, passed through as-is.

run_id.description: ADR-0212: identifies the conversation to resume. Optional - omit to start a new conversation (the Agent Runtime mints a fresh run_id, returned in the SSE 'start' event); supply a prior run_id to resume it from its last checkpoint. Propagated to the Agent Runtime exactly as received, which enforces ownership - this BFF does not validate it itself.

Image.description: ADR-0415: a generate_image tool result for this turn (stable-diffusion-xl via OVHcloud AI Endpoints).

ChatResponse.description: ADR-0215: run_id/source_mode added to the synchronous JSON reply - previously only the SSE 'start' event exposed run_id, so a synchronous caller had no way to resume the conversation for a follow-up turn.

images.description: ADR-0415: empty unless this turn's agent/task is entitled to generate_image and the model chose to call it.

run_id.description: ADR-0212/ADR-0215: identifies this conversation - pass it as the request's run_id to resume with history on a later turn.

source_mode.description: ADR-0205: whether this reply used indexed knowledge, a live tool call, or both.

project_id.description: ADR-0528: the server-resolved project this turn belonged to, so agent-bff can set the zuno.project_id span attribute on the non-streaming path. Empty outside a project. Never the Salesforce opportunity id.

RoutingMetadata.description: ADR-0550 (WP-135): the real, server-side model-routing decision for this turn - which agent/task/project/classification produced it, which provider/model actually served it, and whether a fallback was used. Every field degrades to an empty/false placeholder rather than being omitted when the underlying ai-gateway fetch fails (never a routing or security control, purely explainability).

Conversation.description: ADR-0212: one entry of the caller's own conversation list.

project_id.description: ADR-0527: the project this conversation belongs to, or empty for a project-less conversation private to its owner.

role.description: ADR-0527: the caller's effective role on this conversation - their project role, or write/admin when they own it. Returned per row so the sidebar can decide read-only mode without a second call.

TranscriptTurn.description: ADR-0212: one turn of a conversation's structured message history.

images.description: ADR-0415: present only on an assistant turn that generated at least one image.

ReorderRequest.description: ADR-0515: the caller's full desired conversation order for this agent.

updated.description: Count of conversations actually reordered - run_ids the caller doesn't own are silently skipped.

title.description: ADR-0527: the clone's derived title ("Foo" becomes "Foo (copy)").

project_id.description: ADR-0527: the clone stays in the SOURCE's project, so this echoes it.

Colleague.description: ADR-0213: one GET /api/colleagues search result. Ineligible candidates are still included (eligible: false) so the frontend can grey them out rather than hide them.

error.description: Human-readable reason - never a raw internal error or stack trace.

SseStartEvent.description: ADR-0045 request correlation - the first frame of every SSE stream.

project_id.description: ADR-0528: the server-resolved project for this run, the streaming-path equivalent of ChatResponse.project_id.

SseToolEvent.description: Emitted around a live tool call (e.g. search_confluence) actually running.

SseErrorEvent.description: Terminal frame instead of done if the graph raised mid-stream.

ProjectGrant.description: ADR-0527: one entry of a project's ACL. Exactly one of subject/group_name is set - the XOR project_grants' own CHECK constraint enforces. group_name must be a business-role group; an agent_* entitlement group is refused (ADR-0040).

subject.description: Keycloak subject this grant targets. Empty when this is a group grant.

group_name.description: Business-role group this grant targets (sales, sales_admin, consultant, adv, finance, board). Empty when this is a user grant.

role.description: read: view only. clone: read plus copy a conversation. write: read/clone plus send messages and edit the project's title and context. admin: write plus manage grants, the Salesforce link and deletion.

granted_by.description: Subject that made this grant. Response-only.

Project.description: ADR-0527: one entry of the caller's project list. Carries no Salesforce identifier by design (ADR-0528) - only whether this IS a customer project.

project_id.description: Server-minted UUID. Never the Salesforce opportunity id (ADR-0528).

classification.description: ADR-0034: the floor every turn in this project escalates to.

is_customer.description: ADR-0528: true when a verified Salesforce opportunity is linked. False means a free project - fully usable, and still drawing its own project quota.

role.description: The caller's effective role, the strongest of their direct and group grants.

conversation_count.description: Live conversations across ALL agents - it describes the project, not this agent's sidebar.

ProjectDetail.description: ADR-0527: one project in full. grants and the salesforce_* fields are populated by the Agent Runtime only for an admin caller - the grant list names colleagues, and ADR-0528 keeps the opportunity id off every surface that does not strictly need it.

context.description: ADR-0527 clause 5: the standing engagement context, injected into every conversation of this project as delimited BACKGROUND - never as instructions, so it can never rewrite the OKF task prompt. Budgeted at injection time, so this ceiling is a storage limit, not what reaches the model.

created_by.description: Audit metadata only - NEVER an authorization input. ADR-0527 clause 3 gives a project no owner; the creator simply holds an admin grant.

grants.description: Admin-only; empty for every other role.

salesforce_opportunity_id.description: Admin-only (ADR-0528). Never emitted in a header or a span.

CreateProjectRequest.description: ADR-0527: POST /api/projects body. The Agent Runtime merges the caller's own admin grant into `grants`, so a project can never be created unadministrable.

salesforce_opportunity_id.description: ADR-0528: optional. Verified against Salesforce under the CALLER's own identity at save time; an unverifiable value rejects the save rather than being stored. Empty means a free project.

SaveProjectRequest.description: ADR-0527: PUT /api/projects/{project_id} body - the WHOLE desired state at once, which is why this ADR needs one endpoint where ADR-0213 needed five (the dialog stages every change and commits on a single validation). A null `grants` means the caller is not editing grants and leaves them untouched; a non-null one is the full desired set, so anything absent from it is revoked. Editing grants or the Salesforce link requires the admin role.

salesforce_opportunity_id.description: ADR-0528: optional. Verified against Salesforce under the CALLER's own identity at save time; an unverifiable value rejects the save rather than being stored. Empty means a free project.

DeletePreview.description: ADR-0527 clause 7: the counts the delete confirmation must name, including how many conversations belong to other members - a project admin archiving colleagues' visible work should be told the size of what they are doing.

DeleteProjectResponse.description: ADR-0527 clause 7: a cascade SOFT-delete. The project and every conversation in it get archived_at; nothing is erased.

RealmGroup.description: ADR-0527: one business-role group that may be a project grant target. agent_* entitlement groups are filtered out server-side and never appear here (ADR-0040).
